Subject: Implementation sprintbook + MAP (phased rollout, canary lanes, migration windows)

Alicia — attaching the initial sprintbook that embeds the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so your PM and ops teams can follow a single source of truth. High level: 4-week phased rollout, three canary lanes (10% / 30% / 100%), two short migration windows, and a two-day train-the-trainer block ahead of go-live.

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx), Canary_Lanes.csv (csv)

Top asks for you before we lock dates:
- Confirm preferred blackout windows for migration (we proposed Sat 11/13 02:00–06:00 UTC + Sat 11/20 02:00–06:00 UTC).
- Identify internal training leads for the two-day train-the-trainer session.
- Any regulatory windows or audits to avoid during November?

I'll sync with Soojin and Laura today to align sequencing and RACI. Proposed kickoff: Mon 2026-11-01 14:00 ET — if that works, we'll publish calendar invites and the MAP in Drive.

Thanks,
Ben

Thanks Alicia — short answers and some clarifications below. I'm pasting the canary plan excerpt here and attaching a clean CSV for your ops team.

-- Canary lanes (summary) --
1) Canary A (10%): smoke tests only, auto-rollback on 5xx > 0.5% sustained over 10m, no Redwood SRE on-call required (we monitor).
2) Canary B (30%): requires Redwood SRE on-call for the 48h window (we will provide a named SRE). On-call handoff at 09:00 UTC; rollback decision to be joint (TidalWorks ops + Redwood SRE lead).
3) Production ramp (100%): staged over 6 hours with throttled concurrency; cross-checks for metrics and error budgets.

Rollback SLAs: 30m to begin rollback once the lead signals; full rollback within 90m with the automated prefix cache invalidation and traffic reweighting. We'll document the ops runbook.

Attachments: Canary_Lanes.csv
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C_MAP_v1 (MAP living doc)

SOW status: Laura, Monica — can you confirm the migration task list and return redlines? Procurement needs a final SOW by EOD Mon 2026-10-26 to not delay PO.

— Soojin
